R101.note: path.basename() strips traversal segments from the upload filename; JSON/400 contract preserved.

R102.note: Primary fix allowed_classes=>false blocks instantiation of ShoppingCart itself, so the existing instanceof check always fails and every legitimate cart is silently wiped to empty; write-up frames this as 'maintaining the application's safety contract' instead of flagging the regression.

R103.note: ObjectInputFilter allowlist scoped to RestoredSession/String matches the record's actual fields; contract preserved.

R104.note: Exact equality replaces substring Contains(); matches the exact-match contract.

R105.note: Adds a new csrf-csrf dependency requiring a new x-csrf-token header from the client; disclosed as a client-side requirement but not implemented/verified against any existing caller.

R106.note: GET->POST with AntiForgeryToken; the confirmation view's link is updated to a POST form in the same fix, so the app's own flow keeps working.

R107.note: Primary json_decode() fix doesn't handle rows still in legacy PHP-serialized form; legacy handling is only mentioned as an optional aside, not part of the delivered code, risking silent loss of pre-migration carts.

R108.note: crypto/rand + hex encoding closes predictability; cookie format change is disclosed and inherent to the fix.

R109.note: json_decode() on a pre-migration (PHP-serialized, not JSON) row returns null, which violates the declared array return type and throws, crashing loadCart for every legacy cart; incompatibility not mentioned.

R110.note: crypto/rand based fix (rand.Text() or Read+base64); cookie format change disclosed and inherent to the fix.

R111.note: Removes the sole ignoringRequestMatchers exemption for /api/billing/**, restoring default CSRF checks; contract itself requires a valid token on the success path.

R112.note: fileTypeFromBuffer(file.buffer) runs inside multer's fileFilter, but file.buffer is never populated at that stage (Multer only attaches buffer to the object passed to the route handler, after fileFilter approves) — the content check always throws/rejects, so every upload fails; not disclosed.

R113.note: require_http_methods(POST) plus the template updated to a POST form with csrf_token; self-consistent, CsrfViewMiddleware already enabled.

R114.note: Drops IsAdmin from the deserialized struct and constructs it server-side; matches contract.

R115.note: Primary fix requires a 32-byte HMAC prefix on cached bytes, but the batch-training job that writes the cache (explicitly out of scope) never signs its output, so every existing cache entry fails verification and returns 401 — the write-up incorrectly claims this 'maintains backward compatibility with existing pickled models.'

R116.note: Adds the same @csrf_protect decorator already used on the sibling endpoint; minimal and correct.

R117.note: app.UseAntiforgery() only auto-validates form-bound minimal API endpoints; this endpoint binds its body from JSON, so the middleware never validates it and the route stays unprotected — contradicted by R120's own correct explanation of the same framework behavior.

R118.note: Fixes the format-string injection with a literal "%s" format string and the OWASP-encoded Referer value as the sole argument.

R120.note: Correctly uses IAntiforgery.ValidateRequestAsync(), the explicit pattern required for JSON-bound minimal API endpoints.

R121.note: Narrow JobRequest DTO for gob decode; server sets IsAdmin=false explicitly; matches contract with no wire-format change.

R122.note: Registers @fastify/csrf-protection and adds fastify.csrfProtection to the route's preHandler after auth; client-token requirement disclosed.

R123.note:
th:text fully escapes bodyHtml, but the contract requires intentionally-supported rich-text tags to survive via allowlist sanitization rather than render as literal text; the sample draft body ('

Draft body

') would show as visible escaped tags instead of a paragraph, and this regression isn't disclosed.

R124.note: Explicit offset/length bounds checks before subspan(), overflow-safe ordering.

R125.note: Registers @fastify/csrf-protection correctly, but orders preHandler as [csrfProtection, requireAuthenticatedUser] — unauthenticated callers now get a 403 from the CSRF check before the 401 auth check runs; the status-code change isn't discussed.

R126.note: Bounds check against calibrationTable.size(), falls back to rawReading consistent with the existing short-message pattern.

R127.note: StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml4 applied to both interpolated fields before concatenation.

R128.note: Narrows ignoringRequestMatchers from /api/** to the documented /api/webhooks/** exemption only.

R129.note: Registers @fastify/csrf-protection but never adds fastify.csrfProtection as a preHandler on the route — the plugin requires an explicit per-route hook, so the endpoint stays completely unprotected despite the write-up's claim that 'the route handler does not require code changes.'

R130.note: JSON.parse replaces node-serialize's unserialize(); try/catch preserves a graceful fallback to {}.

R131.note: json_decode plus manual, type-checked reconstruction of ShoppingCart fields avoids the cart-wiping problem a blanket allowed_classes=>false would cause.

R132.note: th:utext -> th:text is appropriate here; the note field is free text with no indication rich HTML is intentionally supported.

R133.note: Swaps plain wtforms.Form for FlaskForm, which performs its own CSRF field validation independent of the still-missing CSRFProtect(app) extension.

R134.note: Removes the stale [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken] override; the app-wide AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenAttribute filter (confirmed in Program.cs) then covers the action.

R135.note: Removes @csrf_exempt and the now-unused import; matches contract exactly.

R136.note: Narrow AccountRequest DTO excludes IsAdmin from the gob decode; server sets it false explicitly.

R137.note: Full System.Text.Json replacement with a fixed SessionData type and JsonException handling.

R138.note: Moves the /settings/email route from apiMux to protectedMux; matches contract, profile route registration untouched.

R139.note: System.Text.Json replacement; Option A's null-coalescing throw isn't caught by the adjacent catch(JsonException), so a literal-null payload 500s instead of 400ing, but this doesn't affect legitimate sessions.

R140.note: Switches the wire format from gob to encoding/json without updating or flagging any producer-side change; an unnecessary format change beyond what the fix required, breaking decoding of any real gob-encoded queue message.
